scope: Owned native Machine full-capture path and private persistent local store implemented and locally verified; separate actual capture KVM gate remains unexecuted. No public native snapshot API, manager orchestration or restore acceptance. Full M4-M6 active.
implemented: Capture validates owned source/control identity, reserves an immutable intent and raw+retained logical byte budget before effects, quiesces/syncs the actual guest and requires observed host Paused.

Snapshot API uses fresh non-overwriting source-jail names and explicit sync_snapshot_files=true. Actual descriptors must have correct owner, type, links and bounded lengths; independently hashed/copied anonymous content goes outside source root before publication.

Private probe obtains random32 bytes inside a live guest process, checks captured RAM and writes a separate drive payload. Source VM/jail/cgroup is explicitly collected, then retained content is reverified; these paths still require their real KVM gate.

Local store root/quota mutex and each content inode bind persistent identity/birth and namespace receipts. Per-capture mutex binds the complete immutable intent; all3 object receipts are declared durably before non-overwriting links and independent readback, with Ready atomic publication last.

Ready readers verify exact reference and complete content without source/producer liveness. Interrupted mutation requires actual original producer and VMM writer absence in the same observed boot/PID namespace; raw-output quota stays reserved until source root is positively absent under its original trusted parent.

Collection first revokes readiness and removes only exact acknowledged object inodes/receipts. Corrupt owned content can collect; replacements and unknown entries are preserved. Unconfirmed/failed capture outcome remains separate from Collected resource phase; tombstones and permanent mutexes are retained.

Private probe-guest --checkpoint-config and checkpoint-inspect/collect exercise this path. Ordinary native-manager/public snapshot integration, aggregate host-memory admission, durable unique restore claims and target loading remain absent.
